en: A vintage black-and-white harbor scene showing a quay with stacked goods and several people working beside moored sailing vessels. One boat with a prominent sail is in the foreground, and additional masts and ships are in the background. Low hills and a windmill can be seen on the far shore. The words "Sæby Havn" are printed on the image, indicating the harbor of Sæby.
